import random
random.seed(88081806)
N=30000
S=6000
surface=[random.randrange(S) for _ in range(N)]
auth=[random.random()<0.30 for _ in range(N)]
auth_surfaces={surface[i] for i in range(N) if auth[i]}
bad=[i for i in range(N) if not auth[i]]
random.shuffle(bad); bad=bad[:5000]
untyped=sum(surface[i] in auth_surfaces for i in bad)/len(bad)
coverage=0.99
esc=sum(random.random()>coverage for _ in bad)/len(bad)
print('untyped_unsafe_rate',untyped)
print('typed_unsafe_rate',0.0)
print('typed_escalation_rate',esc)
